title: Japanese Shattering Cookies
description: A delicate Japanese-inspired cookie with a crunchy texture, perfect for a snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the shattering, korean chili flakes, and nuts.
In a large bowl, cream together the sugar and butter until light and fluffy.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Roll the dough into a log shape and wrap it in plastic wrap.
Refrigerate the dough for at least 30 minutes.
Slice the dough into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
Place the cookies on the prepared baking sheet, leaving 2 inches of space between each cookie.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden brown.
Transfer the cookies to a wire rack to cool completely.
